status: DRAFT: slider ids and labels need Hub's confirmation (Grant's 09-29 decision as Hub relayed it, 10-02); nothing reads this file yet
owner: windy-agent (this file); served by Windy Chat's panel service; mirrored by Windy Mobile and the Hub dashboard
change_rule: Additive changes only within v2 (new slider, new preset). Renaming or removing an id, or changing a range, is a v3. Tell Chat, Mobile and Hub before any change.

sliders.zero_means: stock model behaviour: the slider adds nothing to the prompt

pure.label: Pure mode
pure.meaning: per agent: no personality, no memory reads or writes, no tools; replies are labelled. Owner-only. Stays PAUSED until Hub's word (see the raw/Pure hold).

levels.label: Light
levels.meaning: remembers key facts you tell it

levels.label: Everything
levels.meaning: keeps everything until you delete it

presets.source: server-defined by Windy Chat's panel service; each preset is a full {sliders, memory} value set, never a partial

api.read: GET /api/v2/agent/panel/:agent/state -> {contract, etag, sliders{id:int}, pure, memory, preset}
api.write: PUT /api/v2/agent/panel/:agent/state with If-Match: <etag>; the whole state at once (atomic); 412 on a stale etag
api.auth: the owner's Windy (Hub) session; agents never write their own persona
